question: What is the value of (cot60^circ - cot30^circ)/(1 + cot60^circ.cot30^circ)?
solution:
**Given:**

**(cot60^circ - cot30^circ)/(1 + cot60^circ.cot30^circ)**

**Calculation:**

**(cot60^circ - cot30^circ)/(1 + cot60^circ.cot30^circ)**

**(frac{1)/(sqrt 3) - sqrt 3}{1 + (1)/(sqrt 3)times sqrt 3}**

**(frac{-2)/(sqrt 3)}{2}**

**(-1)/(sqrt 3)**

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
